meta.name: context-builder
meta.description: Generate interactive AI transformation context-builder prompts for consulting clients. Use when creating structured discovery session prompts that guide a company through context gathering about their business, pain points, tech stack, and AI opportunities. Produces a resumable, multi-section prompt with Express/Deep Dive modes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成结构化AI转型咨询引导提示
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为客户做AI转型咨询，需要标准化的引导流程。
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured AI transformation consulting prompts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently conduct AI transformation consulting and need a standardized discovery process.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你通过一系列选择题收集公司信息，然后自动搜索网页和笔记，生成一份结构化的 AI 转型调研提示，包含快速和深度两种模式。
howto.when: 当你需要为咨询客户创建 AI 转型调研提示时触发。

say.text: 帮我为一家 SaaS 公司创建 AI 转型调研提示。
say.note: Claude 会开始询问公司信息并生成提示。

say.text: 为一家制造企业生成深度调研提示，关注流程自动化。
say.note: Claude 会收集信息并生成包含相关章节的提示。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through multiple-choice questions to gather company info, then automatically searches the web and notes to generate a structured AI transformation context-building prompt with Express and Deep Dive modes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create an AI transformation context-building prompt for a consulting client.

say_en.text: Create an AI transformation context-building prompt for a SaaS company.
say_en.note: Claude will start asking questions and generate the prompt.

say_en.text: Generate a deep dive prompt for a manufacturing company focusing on process automation.
say_en.note: Claude will gather info and generate a prompt with relevant sections.
